title: 🔹 The Islamic Republic of Iran's Army has struck U.S. military bases in the UAE and Kuwait with its destructive missiles and drones.
text:
🔹 The Islamic Republic of Iran's Army has struck U.S. military bases in the UAE and Kuwait with its destructive missiles and drones."

"Army Public Relations:"

"🔹 Continuing the series of "lightening" operations and in its 31st phase, in revenge for the pure blood of innocent people and the brave men of the armed forces, early this morning, the Islamic Republic of Iran's Army targeted the "satellite communication systems," "equipment depots," and "fighter aircraft hangars" of the U.S. terrorist army at Kuwait's Ahmed al-Jaber Air Base, using destructive missiles and drones."

"🔹 These strikes inflicted damage and harm on the communication systems and fighter hangars."

"🔹 Furthermore, in continuation of this crushing operation, the "troop deployment areas" and "radar systems" of the child-killing U.S. military at Al Minhad Air Base in the UAE came under attack by the Army's missiles and drones."

"🔹 Ahmed al-Jaber Air Base plays a pivotal role in the logistics and support of the aggressive U.S. military in West Asia, and has had a major impact on that country's aerial and surveillance operations."

"🔹 Al Minhad Air Base is also considered one of the key support and airlift hubs for foreign forces."

"🔹 The Army Public Relations emphasized that the response of the Army's brave men to any attack by the U.S. terrorist army will be hard and devastating, and will continue until final victory and the punishment of the aggressor.
